design: Stocky muscular adult port guard with dark ochre reptilian hide, broad exposed face, blunt mandibles and one broken repaired bronze tusk cap. Medium dreadlocks splay around a thick raised collar. Sleeveless heavy black quilted vest with an X of broad dull bronze metal bands, thick tool belt with three large rectangular cases, heavy wrapped forearms, sturdy charcoal knee apron and visible reptilian lower legs. One hand holds a short closed alien restraint hoop down at thigh, other hand rests on belt. Grounded friendly serious stance.
